title: Transcriptomic partial-reprogramming portability benchmark
description: Code, frozen protocols, aggregate results, figures and manuscript sources for a failure-preserving benchmark of five chronological-age transcriptomic directions across partial-reprogramming studies, with a separately locked post-review robustness extension.
notes: Source code is Apache-2.0; manuscripts, protocols, figures and newly authored aggregate tables are CC BY 4.0. Third-party source data are excluded. Replace this draft with the final deposition metadata and DOI only after author approval.
